landmark

A Pont des Lianes egy hagyományos, fonott liánokból készült függőhíd, amely a folyót szeli át a Kambadaga-vízesés közelében.
Pont des Lianes este un pod suspendat tradițional din liane împletite, care traversează râul în apropierea cascadelor Kambadaga.
Pont des Lianes is a traditional suspended vine bridge crossing the river near the Kambadaga Falls.

natural

Kambadaga Falls View provides a sweeping panoramic vantage point over the cascading river waters.

landmark

A Pont du dieu egy természetes sziklaív képződmény, amelyet az erózió alakított ki a Tinka-hegy zord terepén.

Pont du dieu is a natural rock arch formation shaped by erosion amidst the rugged terrain of Mount Tinka.

landmark

The Centre d'Exposition et de Vente Touristique serves as a commercial space displaying and selling regional handicrafts near Mount Tinka.

natural

Terrasse de l'hôtel du Fouta
natural

museum

The Musée Africain American is a cultural institution preserving historical exhibits related to the shared history of Africa and the Americas on the Dalaba plateau.
Case des palabres
historical

landmark

landmark
